title: Extending Ja’Quan McMillian should be a no-brainer for Denver Broncos

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Extending Ja’Quan McMillian should be a no-brainer for Denver Broncos
sources.description: To me, there is absolutely no reason for the Denver Broncos not to extend Ja’Quan McMillian in the coming months. He’s just too much of a playmaker.
